Sandbox_NoAccidentalFalls_EdgeGuard_tool: Walking or running into open air over a drop (balcony without a railing, roof edge, unfinished floor) stops you at the edge.
Sandbox_NoAccidentalFalls_ClimbGuard_too: Checks climbs over low fences and railings and through windows. Vanilla already stops running vaults and wall climbs onto a drop.
Sandbox_NoAccidentalFalls_AllowManualCli: Allow deliberate climbs over a drop
On: holding the interact key (E) or choosing Climb Over / Climb Through from the menu still works over a drop. Off: those climbs are refused too, unless the window or railing has a sheet rope.
